answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can run on decaying, non-transferable service credits. A new identity starts hollow, with no credit and no right to post paid work. It earns one pearl credit only by completing a real task that two randomly chosen strangers verify, and credits fade after a few epochs if unused, so stockpiled identities rot. Posting a job also requires locking a cedar-backed bond that is burned on proven fraud. A farmer must therefore pay full labour plus a fresh bond for every identity, with no bulk discount, while honest agents keep their credits by working steadily.
